source: Existing loopback console /local/result, bound in memory to its latest manually created phone presentation request; a separate Reference Wallet control is held independently.

correlation.method: The running helper reads its state.presentation transaction ID; user phone screenshots and manual request-generation sequence correlate the submitted card to that request. No new request was generated by this evidence read.

limits: Issuer and holder proof flags are verifier-reported, not reconstructed from screenshots.
No raw presentation, credential, transaction/session identifier or private key is exported.
The console automated mobileAcceptance field is conservative; user storage confirmation and reviewed screenshots are recorded in the manual attempt manifest.
